usedFor: Asyntai AI Chatbot answers visitors on your website; HubSpot is where the people it meets get followed up. A “New Lead Captured” in Asyntai AI Chatbot can run “Create Contact” in HubSpot so chat leads reach your CRM.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Captured” in Asyntai AI Chatbot, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A captured lead is a person who raised their hand in chat, and the action turns that into a HubSpot contact you can assign and follow up.

watchOut: “Create Contact” needs an email, so a chat that ends without one cannot become a contact. “Update Company” also needs a company ID, which a chat event does not supply on its own.
